name: bank-statement-transformer
description: Deterministic native-text bank statement PDF-to-CSV converter

scripts.update: npm run update:check && npm run update:reinstall
scripts.update:reinstall: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm cache clean --force && npm install --before="$(node -p 'new Date(Date.now() - 172800000).toISOString()')"
